resources.string: Type a model or author name to see GGUF models from Hugging Face.
No matching results. Try fewer words or the English name.
Searches automatically once you stop typing.
Results from Hugging Face, ordered by download count.
Search needs a connection. Turn off offline-only mode to browse Hugging Face.
Could not reach Hugging Face. Check your connection and try again.
The free request limit was reached temporarily. Wait a moment and try again.
This content needs a Hugging Face account.
The search could not be completed. Try again.
Could not read this repository. Check the name and the connection, then try again.
This repository has no GGUF file.
Pick a file to see the fit estimate and download it.
Declared by the model publisher, not measured on your device.
Files cannot be read or probed right now. Turn off offline-only mode, then try again.
This repository is gated. Enter a Hugging Face access token to list its files.
The token stays in memory for this session only and is never saved on the device.
The token is held in memory for this session.
The probe reads the first 12 MB of the file over an unmetered connection to learn its architecture and context. You can skip it and download unverified.
The probe downloads up to 12 MB over mobile data. You can wait for Wi-Fi or continue now.
Could not probe the file. Check your connection and try again.
The server does not support partial reads. You can download the file and try later.
These bytes are not a valid GGUF header. The file may be incomplete.
The file is gated; enter a Hugging Face token, then try again.
Could not read the file header. Try again.
The probe did not start: mobile data use was declined. Probe on Wi-Fi or skip it.
Partial read within the 12 MB cap; some fields are unavailable.
A Range request was used, so only one slice was fetched.
The server answered with the file from the start (200) instead of a range (206); not an error, but the server read is not bounded.
From the file header, not from the publisher metadata.
Footprint = file + runtime overhead + KV cache. The numbers are estimates, not measurements.
The file was not probed, so this verdict is unverified; download is allowed but running is not guaranteed.
Download is blocked by the verdict above.
Low-RAM device: a file this large is likely to be killed.
Free memory is not enough for this file.
Free memory is close to the limit; the system may stop the app mid-chat.
Free storage is below 1.1× the file size.
This architecture is not supported by this build engine.
The file architecture was not verified.
The file size is not published.
The whole file will download over mobile data and may use several gigabytes. You can wait for Wi-Fi.
The model may run, but free memory is close to the limit and the system may stop it. The download itself is unaffected.
Added to downloads. Follow the progress on the downloads page.
The download started over mobile data.
This file is already in the download list.
The download could not be added to the list. Try again.
The download did not start: mobile data was declined. It stays in the list until Wi-Fi.
Offline-only mode is on; nothing was added.
The download was added but could not start. Retry it from the downloads page.
